key_messages.message: V4AIR is an interdisciplinary methods-first meetup for students and ECRs to meet collaborators
key_messages.idea: Matchmaking and networking is a core pillar of V4AIR
key_messages.problem_solution: "I need a master's student who can code." / Somewhere in Poland, a master's student needs exactly your project.
key_messages.headline: Meet the people your research needs.
key_messages.microcopy: Tell us who you want to meet. We put you in the room with them.

key_messages.message: V4AIR is for practitioners across fields who implement AI methods, rather than being exclusive to any single field OR to those developing/researching AI directly
key_messages.idea: The meetup is methods-first, not fields-first
key_messages.problem_solution: "I wonder if we could do something else with this method" / You probably can. Find out at V4AIR.
key_messages.headline: Should you apply? If AI is part of your research, yes.
key_messages.microcopy: A biologist training models on field data and a historian mining digitized archives both belong at V4AIR.

key_messages.message: Participation is fully funded for participants from partner institutions
key_messages.idea: There is no cost to participants for attending
key_messages.problem_solution: "I can't pay for another conference this year." / At V4AIR you don't have to. Partner-university participants pay nothing.
key_messages.headline: Free and fully funded
key_messages.microcopy: No participation fee. Accommodation at the castle, meals, and a contribution toward travel are covered by the International Visegrad Fund.

key_messages.message: **ECRs** can find collaborators and team members, consult experts and explore paths to industry
key_messages.idea: Participants meet the right people to advance their careers
key_messages.problem_solution: "I need a co-author from outside my field" / She's coming to V4AIR this April. Come meet her.
key_messages.headline: Find your next collaborator at V4AIR.
key_messages.microcopy: Tell us what expertise your project is missing. We invite people who match.

key_messages.message: **Students** can find mentors, research positions, get feedback on ideas, and apply know-how in new contexts
key_messages.idea: Participants meet the right people to advance their careers
key_messages.problem_solution: "I have no idea what I'm doing after my masters" / Spend 3 days at a castle finding out.
key_messages.headline: Find a mentor at V4AIR.
key_messages.microcopy: Present your project in the Not-Just-Posters session and get feedback, even before you have results.

key_messages.message: V4AIR is not a formal academic conference (no proceedings) but rather an interdisciplinary meetup
key_messages.goal: Ensure a valuable and positive experience for participants by setting expectations
key_messages.idea: You do not need a finished paper or results
key_messages.problem_solution: You do not need an abstract or a finished paper. Come get feedback on what you're currently working on.
key_messages.headline: You do not need a paper to apply
key_messages.microcopy: Works in progress and projects that got stuck are welcome.

key_messages.message: V4AIR brings together students and early-career researchers who apply AI, from six universities in the four Visegrad countries
key_messages.goal: Positive recognition among secondary target audiences
key_messages.idea: V4AIR connects AI talent across the Visegrad region
key_messages.problem_solution: "We want our researchers working with colleagues across the V4." / V4AIR puts them in one place for three days.
key_messages.headline: Young AI researchers from four countries meet at Kostelec Castle.
key_messages.microcopy: Supported by the International Visegrad Fund, Grant No. 22610317.

key_messages.message: You shape the V4AIR programme: it is built from what you want to learn and who you want to meet
key_messages.goal: Ensure a valuable and positive experience for participants by setting expectations
key_messages.idea: The programme is built from what you say you want to learn, who you want to meet and what interests you.
key_messages.problem_solution: The programme adapts to you, not the other way around.
key_messages.headline: Your answers build the programme.
key_messages.microcopy: Tell us what you want to learn. We choose the talks and speakers from your answers.

hooks.hook: Students and researchers who use AI: this April, we put you in a room with the collaborators you ask for.
Would you rather cold-email strangers for a collaborator, or spend three days with the ones you picked?
At V4AIR, your application decides who sits at your table.
If you need a student who can code or a co-author from another field, V4AIR is where you meet them.
Biologists and historians who use AI: this meetup was built for you.
You don't have to build AI to belong at an AI meetup.
If you're a linguist probing what models learn, V4AIR is for you.
Read this if you use AI in a field outside computer science.
Students and researchers at the six partner universities: three days at a castle near Prague, and your stay is paid for.
Would you spend three days at a castle near Prague if the International Visegrad Fund paid for your stay?
No conference budget this year? At V4AIR, partner-university participants pay no fee and stay at the castle for free.
Apply by 15 January if you want three funded days at Kostelec Castle.
Postdocs looking for a collaborator outside your field: V4AIR introduces you before you arrive.
If your next grant needs a partner from another V4 country, you can meet them at Kostelec this April.
Who is missing from your team? Tell us, and we invite people who match.
Considering a move to industry after your PhD? Talk to people from industry at V4AIR before you decide.
If you can code, V4AIR can introduce you to researchers who need that skill.
Finishing your master's with no plan yet? Meet researchers and people from industry at V4AIR this April.
Bring your half-finished project to V4AIR and get feedback from researchers in other fields.
At V4AIR, students spend three days living and working alongside the researchers they want to learn from.
No results yet? You can still present at V4AIR.
If your project got stuck, bring it to V4AIR. We want to hear about it.
No abstract and no finished paper: V4AIR asks what you are working on now.
PhD students with an unfinished project: apply before 15 January.
Young researchers from Prague, Budapest, Bratislava, Wrocław and Toruń who apply AI will spend three days in one castle this April.
University leaders in the V4: your researchers will meet their counterparts from three other countries at Kostelec in April.
Where do the Visegrad region's young AI researchers meet each other? On 28–30 April 2027, at Kostelec Castle.
Investors looking for AI talent in Central Europe: V4AIR brings it to one castle for three days.
At most conferences, the organisers pick the talks. At V4AIR, your application does.
Tell us what you want to learn by 15 January. We'll build the programme around it.
What would you put on the programme if you could choose? At V4AIR, you can.
If you've ever sat through a talk that had nothing to do with your work, this programme is built differently.
